title: Activities to Change Your Mood: A Test of the Acceptability and Initial Efficacy in Clinical Samples and Healthy Controls
official: Activities to Change Your Mood: A Test of the Acceptability and Initial Efficacy in Clinical Samples and Healthy Controls
summary: This is a study investigating how brief online activities can influence mood and attitudes.
